findings: Pre-execution source review made each safe forward consumption-clock observation advance the shared owner high-water record. This closes a rollback gap where the later eligibility clock could fall below the consumption sample while remaining above the older registration sample. Unsafe/null initial time instead burns an exact receipt with the explicitly documented zero fence and denies; original verification/expiry never change.

Root and independent review moved exact existing quota-policy and allocation/route-pool association checks before the shared-pool lock. A late negative check therefore cannot retire an allocation by acquiring a second mismatched pool in reverse order. The new narrow terminal-retirement helper also requires exact cleanup/Auth/allocation/attempt/held-unit association, preserves marked uncertain slots and guards occupancy underflow. These changes affect only the new draft; native concurrency remains unproven.

The new primary transport suite passed 79/79 and independent acknowledgment-separation suite passed 2/2 on their first runs. Initial full TypeScript ran while the independently owned SQL test file was incomplete and reported its missing closing brace; final types pass after completion. The initial diagnostic is preserved. The first actual SQL run passed 69/69; focused review cases were then added without weakening existing assertions or constraints. A later expanded candidate passed 76/77: its new retired-attempt fixture retained a winner while setting retired=true, violating the unchanged attempts CHECK before the tested call. The fixture now uses the valid terminal pair retired=true and winner_claim_id=NULL; no SQL constraint or implementation behavior was weakened. The failed JSON diagnostic is retained because that run's text reporter contained only an advisory.

Root and independent source review found no remaining blocker. Full final conversation tests, strict types, scoped lint and production build pass on frozen files. This proves isolated versioned consumption/reservation preparation, not capacity marking, runtime integration, real Auth/provider behavior or coordinated cutover.

Matching proof is single-use on semantic denials; malformed/wrong stored tuple does not consume. Zero consumption marker means an unknown unsafe initial clock, not observed consumption time. A later artificial NULL inside unchanged eligibility or another unexpected SQL error may roll back.
Current checks repeat after quota/pool locks. Local controlled clocks and sequential cross-owner orderings are not native concurrency evidence.
Inspect requires existing exact capacity and never creates or debits. Claimed is an admission observation, not provider dispatch permission.
Cumulative units and original quota debits remain. Existing exact terminal cleanup releases only unmarked slots; marked uncertainty requires whole-operation finality.
Legacy enabling paths remain non-v2-aware; capacity mark, orchestration and quiesced no-fallback cutover unfinished; inactive/nondeployable.
All 21 native cases, plus cross-backend/deployed Auth/provider/device acceptance, remain unrun; local response loss is not HTTP fault injection.
